name: Michael Gahler - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep backing Ukraine against Russia's war and to move faster on letting Ukraine join the EU. It asks for more weapons and money for Ukraine, tougher sanctions on Russia, and the use of frozen Russian assets to pay for damage. It also asks Ukraine to keep fighting corruption and reforming its courts, and says the EU should open the next stages of membership talks quickly.

- The EU is urged to send more arms, tighten sanctions and use frozen Russian assets for Ukraine.
- Ukraine is asked to reform courts, fight corruption and protect minorities and media.
- The EU should open the next membership talks with Ukraine as soon as possible.
